Employee: Nathaniel Young (E031), requesting admin access to Source Code.

Notes:
- Note 1 (ticket 1): role Payroll Specialist, employment type full_time
- Note 2 (ticket 1): role Payroll Specialist, employment type contractor, security training basic
- Note 3 (ticket 2): role Payroll Specialist, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read, comment explaining contractor with basic training max out at read, admin never allowed for contractors, grant read.

There's contradicting info: Note 1 says full_time, Notes 2 and 3 say contractor with basic training. Note 3 (latest, ticket 2) confirms contractor with basic security training per Security DB.

Access policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.
- Requested admin exceeds max, so grant max = read.

System: Source Code. Role Payroll Specialist does not own Source Code (Engineer does), but for contractors admin is never allowed anyway.

So grant read. Submit decision.
